## About
Mel's Reset is a family-run car repair shop in Miami. We work on everyday problems like brakes and check engine lights, and on bigger jobs like engine rebuilds, AC overhauls and accident damage.
We like to keep things simple: tell you what's wrong, show you, and give you the price up front. One customer said we text photos of what's wrong and never push unnecessary work. Another said Mel was honest from the beginning and told him how much everything was upfront.
We're open weekdays. Give us a call or send a message about what's going on with your car, and we'll get back to you with a quote.

## Services
- Insurance company back and forth: We can handle the back and forth with your insurance company so you don't have to.
- Brakes and engine light diagnostics: Brake work, engine light diagnostics and the small issues that come up as a car racks up miles.
- AC system overhaul: When the air conditioning quits, we can overhaul the system, including a new compressor and blower.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed on weekends.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Send us a message letting us know what's going on with your vehicle, and we'll get back to you with a quote.

Q: Will I know the price before you start?
A: We aim to be upfront. One customer said Mel told him how much everything was before the work began.
